name: tokenjuice
install_doc: `npm install -g tokenjuice`, then `tokenjuice install claude-code`. The image installs the pinned package. Each run executes the vendor's installer in the sandboxed HOME, which writes one PreToolUse Bash hook (`tokenjuice claude-code-pre-tool-use --wrap-launcher ...`) into settings.json.
notes: Bash output compaction through a PreToolUse wrapper. The 2026-09-03 ledger campaign measured 0.8.1.
